traits.name: Aura of Authority
traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hobgoblin makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +4, range 150/600 ft. _Hit:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage. ## Homunculus
